title: ErrorEnvelope
description: Body of every non-200 response (contract v0.1.0). Codes used in Module 0: INVALID_JSON (400), VALIDATION_ERROR (400), PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE (413), UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE (415, body is not application/json), NOT_FOUND (404), INTERNAL_ERROR (500). ANALYZER_UNAVAILABLE (503) is reserved for Module 1. Clients should handle unknown codes generically.
